threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still say 'Hackney' like it’s the whole borough instead of 'Dalston' or 'Stokey'. You’re gonna get called out soon.
Caught two blokes arguing over a missing shoe on the 59 last night. One was convinced it’d magically return at Stockwell. Classic Brixton madness.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Heard a toddler arguing with their parent over what flavor of ice cream they should get outside Eiscafé Bacio. That’s when it hit me—this place feels like home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a currywurst stand with its own mini disco ball. It’s the last place you'd expect to dance while waiting for your snack!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a true local by their eye roll when someone suggests renting bikes to explore; we prefer our worn-out shoes and the bus, thank you.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the bus, umbrella in hand, while the rain poured down. Only in SF do we dress for the occasion, no matter the transport.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but it’s the small plazas and hidden bars that keep us coming back, not the crowds.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their confusion over the 15-minute rule at local cafés—waiting for someone to bring the bill instead of asking for it.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep calling it the Overground instead of just the 'train'—everyone here knows it's just part of the commute.
Last Saturday on the 208, a bloke in a dinosaur costume argued with the driver about bus fare. Never thought I'd see a T-Rex at 2 AM.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a toddler arguing with a street artist over the best spray paint color on a Sunday afternoon at Herrfurthplatz.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a kebab joint open at 5 AM that serves as the last stop for the club crowd, complete with an outdoor dance floor.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a local knows not to flinch when the Muni stops for 'maintenance,' letting a dog off the tracks. Tourists just stare, puzzled.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a full tuxedo waiting for the 5-Fulton, umbrella in hand, while a dog casually strolled along the tracks. Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just waltz into a vermut bar and order a sangria, but locals know the real drink is a 'vermut amb llimona' on a Sunday.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their bewilderment at the ferocity of the ferrets in the Park Güell fountain. Locals just dodge them like pros.
